contact.address: 470, 80 Feet Rd, Hal, HAL 3rd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075

colour_palette.details: Black and gold minimal palette on paper, but live website serves default unstyled HTML due to broken asset links and crawler blocking.

logo.details: Royal heraldic crest logo exists on Instagram, but is missing from the website markup and Open Graph metadata.

typography.details: Falls back to system serif/sans-serif defaults with no custom web typography hierarchy loaded.

contact.details: Phone number accessible via Google Maps and Zomato, but website lacks a working direct contact or table reservation form.

online_presence.details: Website responds with HTTP configuration errors / robots.txt blocks and lacks modern mobile responsiveness.

verdict.commercial_rationale: High-end luxury burger boutique in Indiranagar serving French brioche Traiteur burgers, truffle parmesan fries, and premium mocktails. Their culinary offering is elite, making a luxury cinematic website an immense win.

sample_website.notes: Parisian luxury culinary atelier redesign highlighting brioche smash artistry (Lucien, Dynamit, Firestarter).
